test_inputs.explanation: The agent navigated to the Magento invoices area at http://dockerized-magento.local/index.php/admin/sales_invoice/ and then opened an invoice detail page at /admin/sales_invoice/view/invoice_id/42. From that, base_url is set to http://dockerized-magento.local and the invoice identifier used is 42 (placed in invoice_number here to reproduce the opened view). All other filters/options were not present in the execution and are left empty. open_invoice is true because the agent opened the invoice detail URL.
